verdict.rationale: The product's source is publicly hosted at github.com/hashicorp/terraform, so it can be read. The only support for an open license is a 2021 community comment thanking HashiCorp for 'keeping it open source' and a reference to a CLA for contributions. The pack contains no first-party license statement and nothing establishing the current license terms. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the license, current evidence that the license is OSI-approved or otherwise open, and independent corroboration of present-day licensing.
